name: No Risk Assessment / Method Statement
description: No documented RAMS for the works.

name: No daily toolbox talks
description: Workers start the day without briefing on hazards.

name: PPE not enforced
description: Hard hat, hi-vis, safety boots etc. not consistently worn.

name: No site perimeter / segregation
description: Members of public can enter the work zone.

name: No traffic management plan
description: Vehicle movement, deliveries and pedestrians not segregated.

name: No CIS / payroll-tax process
description: No documented withholding or verification process.

name: No permit / approval tracker
description: No central register of permits, conditions and expiry dates.

name: No site security
description: Site unfenced or unlit overnight; no CCTV.

name: No tool / plant register
description: Tools and plant not registered or tagged.
